Package dev.px.core.event

Class Event

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.event.Event
Direct Known Subclasses:
CancellableEvent, ClientLifecycleEvent, ConfigLoadEvent, ModuleToggleEvent, Render2DEvent, Render3DEvent, SettingChangeEvent, WorldEvent
public abstract class Event extends Object
Marker base for everything posted on the EventBus.

Plain events carry no behaviour of their own. Extend CancellableEvent when handlers must be able to suppress the underlying action, and StagedEvent when the same call site fires before and after that action.
